failure_modes: Selecting C001-C003 (pointcloud_delta_A) would alter the robust kernel curvature without any evidence that shape-coupled contrast is expressed by the pointcloud scalar; the shape signal is a coordinate contrast, not a kernel-bandwidth effect, so the edit would displace surrounding coordinates without targeting the observed shape_yy/shape_xx direction.

Selecting C004-C006 (teacher_neighbors) treats neighbor count as a distance bandwidth; the Analyst evidence gives no bandwidth or mode-coverage justification, and changing k would shift the teacher mixture without addressing the shape-coupled contrast, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.

Selecting C007-C009 (temporal_teacher_blend) changes only dose of the same static teachers; with no validated absolute contrast change at observed score nodes and no decoded terminal labels, the blend cannot be shown to improve the affinity-primary objective and may amplify unvalidated teacher coordinates.

Any edit here would be justified by coordinate contrasts that are not physical interaction energies or affinity benefit; treating them as such would violate the affinity-first priority and the declared semantics.
rationale: Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint signal is shape-coupled (shape_yy integrated z ~ -0.51, zero positive batch fraction; shape_xx ~ -0.50), while centroid terms are weaker or null. H001/H002 point toward a time-conditioned regional attention rule modulating landmark occupancy/softmin contrast at observed score nodes, not toward any of the offered scalar choices. The registered choices only expose pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), teacher_neighbors count (C004-C006) and temporal_teacher_blend (C007-C009). None of these is a shape-coupled regional attention edit: delta changes the robust pointcloud kernel curvature, neighbor count changes the teacher count, and blend changes only the temporal dose of the same static teachers. Curve support is restricted (24/200 features pass; fidelity audit is a container summary only), and no decoded terminal labels exist, so no offered scalar has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent (pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, no temporal blend). Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported choice; the shape-coupled regional attention direction remains a hypothesis requiring a validated contrast fit before any edit.
